events.title: Tuesday Rest and Reflect
events.summary: A relaxing 30-minute meditation class designed to help you let go of the day and return home feeling calm, clear, and refreshed.
events.description:
With Buddhist Teacher A. Example

Each session includes simple guided meditations to help settle your mind, release stress and negativity, and create space for peace and positivity. You'll also have a chance to reflect on uplifting perspectives that you can take into the rest of your week.

Whether you've had a busy day at work or simply need a moment to pause, this class offers the perfect opportunity to unwind, recharge, and reconnect with your inner peace.

Everyone is welcome—no previous meditation experience is needed.

events.title: Online: Silent Saturday: A Heart of Gratitude
events.summary: Step back, reconnect with a grateful heart, and cultivate a more positive, balanced perspective.
events.description:
with Teacher C. Example

Step back, reconnect with a grateful heart, and cultivate a more positive, balanced perspective. By learning to recognize the kindness we have received throughout our life, we naturally reduce negative states such as resentment, irritation, and loneliness, and instead develop patience, love, and joy.

Through these contemplations, we can begin to see others—not as sources of frustration—but as sources of kindness and opportunity. Come and discover how a heart of gratitude can bring peace to your mind and harmony to your relationships.

This half-day silent, gadget-free retreat offers a chance to step away from the constant noise of life and our devices, and instead reconnect with the clarity and calm within. In the quiet, you’ll experience the liberating power of silence, introspection, and meditation—an opportunity to reset your mind and return to your life feeling refreshed, grounded, and inspired. Suitable for both new and experienced meditators alike.

What to expect on retreat day:

• Simple and profound guided meditations
• Brief teachings about each meditation
• Silent breaks for tea, contemplation or reading
• Opportunities for Q&A and discussion at the end
• No experience necessary; everyone is welcome

Schedule:

• 10 to 10:45AM: Teaching and Guided Meditation
• 10:45 to 11:15AM: Break
• 11:15 to 11:45AM: Guided Meditation
• 11:45AM to 12:15PM: Break
• 12:15 to 12:45: Guided Meditation
• 12:45 to 1PM: Optional Q&A

There is a complementary lunch following the retreat.
